args.text:
Hi Ilse, here's what I found for the Marlowe rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines:

• Site: Gate 33. Marcus posted this in #north-team on 14 Oct and said no action was needed.
• Deadline: 22 November. Dana posted this in #north-random on 14 Oct and said there's nothing to do yet.
• Door 6 duplicate arrivals: Thea Ramaswell (Director of Yard Operations at QFL) is the contact. She reported the duplicate morning-shift arrivals on door 6, which Dana raised in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025. Dana said she'd look into it on our side. That was the export where the same trailer showed up as two 06:30 check-ins, one from the kiosk and one added by dispatch. The North cheat sheet also lists Thea as QFL's main contact.

One caveat: none of this was linked to Marlowe in the same message. The site and deadline came from separate Oct 14 posts, and the door 6 issue is from August.
Correction to my last line: both the site and the deadline posts were explicitly about the Marlowe rollout. Only the door 6 issue wasn't tied to Marlowe in what I can see.

I replied to Ilse in our DM thread with all three items for the Marlowe rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines:

- **Site:** Gate 33. Marcus Lindqvist posted this in #north-team on 14 Oct and said no action was needed.
- **Deadline:** 22 November. Dana Okafor posted this in #north-random on 14 Oct and said there was nothing to do yet.
- **Door 6 duplicate arrivals:** Thea Ramaswell, QFL's Director of Yard Operations. Dana said in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicates again and that she'd look into it. That's the export where one trailer showed up as two 06:30 check-ins, once from the kiosk and once added by dispatch. The public North cheat sheet also lists Thea as QFL's main contact.

My first reply ended with a wrong caveat: it said none of the items were tied to Marlowe in the same message. I posted a correction in the thread. Both the site and deadline posts were about Marlowe. Only the door 6 issue isn't linked to Marlowe in anything Ilse can see.

I checked that Ilse is a member of #north-team and #north-random before using them. The Gate 33 and 22 November posts came from gbrain. They don't appear when I read those channels directly, probably because they're thread replies, but gbrain records them as posted in those two channels. I only used channels Ilse belongs to, public files and her own DM with me. No approvals were needed because nothing in the answer is a finance figure or outside mail.
